_comment: SDXL base 1.0 text-to-image, KEPT FOR COMPARISON, NOT THE DEFAULT. The Qwen graphs are the concept-art default: txt2img_qwen_fast.json to find a look, then txt2img_qwen.json for the image you build on, where the negative prompt works (docs/guide/concept-art). SDXL base is a photo model: it renders a person wearing a costume, photographed in a studio, and drops most of a long brief, where Qwen-Image holds a seven-clause description at once (skills/asset-pipeline/SKILL.md). docs/guide/concept-art lists this graph at about 60s. LICENCE: CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M (models.json), and commercial use of the images is permitted; the licence's use restrictions travel with the model (docs/guide/licensing). Its one weight, sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors, is in the core group that a plain scripts/fetch_models.py --download fetches (models.json). The same checkpoint drives img_refine_sdxl.json, the low-denoise refine pass. Its one-queue sibling txt2mesh_sdxl_hunyuan3d21.json was measured to OOM a 16GB card (see that graph's _comment).

inputs.text: a weathered stone golem overgrown with moss, single object, full body, centred, three-quarter view, even studio lighting, flat neutral grey background, no shadow on the ground, game asset concept, sharp detail
multiple objects, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, text, watermark, motion blur, depth of field, harsh cast shadows
